title: Present Simple
summary: Talk about habits, routines, facts, and things that are generally true — "She works from home", "Water boils at 100°C".
whyThisTopic: It's the foundation for most everyday English — a good place to start before your lessons adapt to how you do on the check.

assessmentConfig._note: Temporarily 2 for faster testing — production value is 3. questionsPerSubSkill and qualifyingScore must move together: if qualifying > drawn, nobody can ever skip a sub-skill.

feedback.en: **isn't / aren't** negates a state, not an action. A present-simple action needs **don't** or **doesn't**.
feedback.bn: **isn't / aren't** state-কে negative করে, action-কে নয়। Action-এর জন্য **don't** বা **doesn't** লাগে।

feedback.en: After **do / does / don't / doesn't** the verb stays base — the **-s** has already moved into the auxiliary.

lessons.title: I, you, we, they — the base verb

blocks.text: With **I**, **you**, **we**, **they** and any plural subject, the verb stays in its **base form**. Nothing is added.

blocks.label: Watch out
blocks.text: The **-s** belongs to **he / she / it** only. Adding it anywhere else — *I works*, *they lives* — is the most common slip.

blocks.text: Don't drop the auxiliary. *Where he works?* is the most common slip — it needs **does**: *Where does he work?* And the **-s** stays on **does**, never on the main verb.

blocks.label: ব্যাখ্যা
blocks.text: তথ্য জানতে প্রশ্ন করতে প্রথমে **wh-** word, তারপর **do** বা **does**, তারপর subject, তারপর verb-এর **base form** বসে। **-s** থাকে **does**-এ, মূল verb-এ নয়। *Where he works?* — এখানে **does** বাদ পড়েছে, এটি ভুল।

feedback.en: The auxiliary **do** is missing.
feedback.bn: Auxiliary **do** বাদ পড়েছে।

feedback.en: After **do** the verb stays base — **need**.
feedback.bn: **do**-এর পরে verb base form-এ থাকে।

feedback.en: Correct. **What** + **do** + subject + base verb.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। **What** + **do** + subject + verb-এর base form।

feedback.en: **You** takes **do**, not **does**.
feedback.bn: **You**-এর সাথে **do** বসে, **does** নয়।

feedback.en: The auxiliary **does** is missing.
feedback.bn: Auxiliary **does** বাদ পড়েছে।

feedback.en: **She** needs **does**.
feedback.bn: **She**-এর সাথে **does** বসে।

feedback.en: Correct. **She** takes **does**, and the verb stays base.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। **She**-এর সাথে **does**, আর verb base form-এ।

feedback.en: The **-s** is already in **does**.
feedback.bn: **-s** ইতিমধ্যে **does**-এ আছে।

feedback.en: **They** is plural, so it takes **do**.
feedback.bn: **They** plural, তাই **do** বসে।

feedback.en: The auxiliary comes before the subject: **When do they…**
feedback.bn: Auxiliary subject-এর আগে বসে: **When do they…**

feedback.en: After **do** the verb stays base.
feedback.bn: **do**-এর পরে verb base form-এ থাকে।

feedback.en: Correct. **They** takes **do**.
feedback.bn: ঠিক আছে। **They**-এর সাথে **do** বসে।
